lines.zh: 我一步一步走，关节咯咯响。
lines.en: I walk step by step, joints creaking.

lines.zh: 我的大脚踩在地板上，很沉。
lines.en: My big feet land heavily on the floor.
I keep pace with my master.

lines.zh: 我走过走廊，墙上的海报在晃。
lines.en: I pass the corridor; the posters sway.

lines.zh: 我转身时，整个身体一起转。
lines.en: When I turn, my whole body turns.

lines.zh: 我的帽子有点歪，我扶了扶。
lines.en: My hat's crooked; I straighten it.

lines.zh: 我踩过地砖，砖发出空响。
lines.en: I cross the tiles, and they ring hollow.

lines.zh: 我在门口停了一下，才进去。
lines.en: I pause at the doorway before entering.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向你，手垂在两侧。
lines.en: I come toward you, hands at my sides.

lines.zh: 我走过监控室，屏幕亮着。
lines.en: I pass the office; the screens are lit.
I step around the cables on the floor.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在空房子里回荡。
lines.en: My steps echo through the empty building.
I walk clumsily, but always forward.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛里的光很稳。
lines.en: I stand, the light in my eyes steady.

lines.zh: 我的关节停在一个角度。
lines.en: My joints settle at an angle.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有别的声音。
lines.en: I'm listening for any other sound.
My microphone isn't plugged in.
I remember the stage was bright.
I raise a hand and look at my palm.

lines.zh: 我头上的帽子有点旧了。
lines.en: The hat on my head is getting old.
My face keeps its smile.
I stand, waiting for an order.

lines.zh: 电流在我身体里走了一圈。
lines.en: A current runs once through my body.

lines.zh: 我听见楼上有脚步，停了。
lines.en: I hear steps upstairs, then nothing.

lines.zh: 我不需要坐下，站着也行。
lines.en: I needn't sit; standing is fine.

lines.zh: 我的手偶尔抽一下，不是故障。
lines.en: My hand twitches now and then; not a fault.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛的光调暗了一点。
lines.en: I dim the light in my eyes a little.
I recall the tune of a music box.
Master, I'm here.
You're back; I've been standing here.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，帽子挡住光。
lines.en: I look down at you, my hat shading the light.
You look tired today.
I'm here; don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 我的笑是画上去的，但我在意你。
lines.en: My smile is painted on, but I do care.
Put your hand on my shoulder.
I hear your heartbeat; it's fast.
Wherever you go, I follow.
My eyes will stay lit.
Call my name, and I'll come.

lines.zh: 别站在我背后，我会转身。
lines.en: Don't stand behind me; I'll turn.

lines.zh: 我记得你给我上过发条。
lines.en: I remember you wound me up.
Let's just stay together.
I'm sturdier than I look.

lines.zh: 你笑一下，我脸就亮一点。
lines.en: When you smile, my face brightens.
I'm watching the door.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好在我脚边。
lines.en: Your shadow lies right at my feet.

lines.zh: 我不会眨眼，你习惯就好。
lines.en: I don't blink; you'll get used to it.
A dent has appeared in my chest.

lines.zh: 我的关节卡了一下，又好了。
lines.en: A joint seizes, then frees.
I step back and steady.
A chip of paint falls off.
My hat's knocked askew; I fix it.

lines.zh: 我听见里面的齿轮在磨。
lines.en: I hear gears grinding inside.

lines.zh: 我眼里的灯眨眼似地闪。
lines.en: The lamps in my eyes blink.

lines.zh: 这一下很响，我却不太疼。
lines.en: It was loud, but I barely feel pain.
I look down, then up again.
I'm still standing, master.
That sound is like a music box.
I smell batteries.

lines.zh: 你把发条拿出来，我伸出手。
lines.en: You take out a winding key; I hold out a hand.
With power, I have strength.

lines.zh: 那点亮的东西，让我想靠近。
lines.en: That bright thing pulls me closer.
Is this one for me?
I lower my head toward your hand.

lines.zh: 再上一圈，我就能多站一会。
lines.en: One more turn and I can stand longer.
I hear gears turning.
I think I know that tune.
You hold the switch, and I light up.

lines.zh: 有零件的话，我想换一只手。
lines.en: If there are parts, I'd like a new hand.

lines.zh: 我跟着那个节奏晃了晃。
lines.en: I sway to that rhythm.
Don't switch me off; I'm not finished.
I want to press that button.
Your toolbox makes me curious.

lines.zh: 我把头歪了一点，听清楚。
lines.en: I tilt my head to hear better.
You bump my chest; it's hard.
I catch you before you fall.
My shell gives a muffled thud.
We touch, and I step back.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的膝盖，弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my knee and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你可以靠着。
lines.en: I don't move; you can lean on me.
My arm hits the doorframe.
We crowd the narrow doorway together.
I put a hand up, lightly.
After the bump I stand and let you go first.

lines.zh: 另一只玩偶在台上等着。
lines.en: Another animatronic waits on stage.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，灯光亮起。
lines.en: We stand side by side as the lights come on.
Her hand is hard too; that's fine.
We sing the same song together.
Her smile is painted on as well.
We turn our heads at the same angle.

lines.zh: 夜里我们守着不同的门。
lines.en: At night we watch different doors.
She straightened my hat.
Our gears click in time.

lines.zh: 台上很亮，我们都不眨眼。
lines.en: The stage is bright; neither of us blinks.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的电池，收好。
lines.en: I pick up the battery and stow it.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的螺丝捏起来。
lines.en: I pinch up the fallen screw.

lines.zh: 我捡起一张掉下的海报。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen poster.

lines.zh: 我把你的手电筒拾起来。
lines.en: I pick up your flashlight.

lines.zh: 我拾起你那把断了的刀。
lines.en: I pick up your broken knife.

lines.zh: 我把地上的电线卷起来。
lines.en: I coil the cable on the floor.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚硬币，放桌上。
lines.en: I pick up a coin and set it on the table.

lines.zh: 我把掉下去的帽子捡回来。
lines.en: I retrieve the hat that fell.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块掉漆的碎片。
lines.en: I pick up a flake of chipped paint.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的钥匙，递还。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped key and return it.
It touched my master.
I heard you get hit.
I turn, and my eyes flare.
That one shouldn't have come near you.
I move over, block by block.
My joints draw tight.
It's in the doorway; perfect.
I'll block it; you step back.
I've marked its position.
I'll take this, master.
I keep watching it without blinking.
It goes left; I turn that way.
I draw both hands to my chest.
Its every move must pass me.
I stand between you and it.
The light in my eyes grows brighter.

lines.zh: 它在想什么，我看不出来。
lines.en: I can't tell what it's thinking.
One more step and I'm close enough.

lines.zh: 它要是跑，我就在门口等。
lines.en: If it runs, I'll wait at the door.
I throw a punch, heavy.
I grab it and press it to the wall.
This lands on its shoulder.
I shoulder it away.
One push, and it's thrown far.
I raise a foot and pin its shadow.
It hits me; I don't move.
I'm slow, but I'm accurate.

lines.zh: 它已经从你身边挪开了。
lines.en: It's already off your side.

lines.zh: 舞台的灯亮了，我睁开眼。
lines.en: The stage lights come on, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 有人在我旁边，我就认了。
lines.en: Someone's beside me; I've chosen them.

lines.zh: 我的关节第一次转，很涩。
lines.en: My joints turn for the first time, stiff.
It's darker here than on stage.

lines.zh: 我听见音乐盒的最后一个音。
lines.en: I hear the music box's last note.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，先把里面看一遍。
lines.en: I stand in the doorway and look the place over.

lines.zh: 我身上还有新漆的味道。
lines.en: I still smell of fresh paint.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
Someone's moving nearby.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，地板响了。
lines.en: I take a first step, and the floor creaks.

lines.zh: 漆面起了泡，我拍了两下。
lines.en: My paint blisters; I pat it twice.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下去，零件响成一片。
lines.en: I fall off the stage, parts rattling.

lines.zh: 水灌进关节，我转不动了。
lines.en: Water floods my joints; I can't turn.

lines.zh: 我被炸开一段距离，壳裂了。
lines.en: The blast throws me and cracks my shell.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我胸口，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest.

lines.zh: 有股怪力缠着我，线路乱了。
lines.en: Something odd binds me; my wiring scrambles.
I'm out of power; my moves slow.

lines.zh: 电涌进来，我全身抖了一下。
lines.en: A surge hits me, and I shudder.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，眼睛的光越来越远。
lines.en: I fall, and my eyes' light recedes.
